# Shepherd of Hermas Chapter 69 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** P.Mich. 130, Shepherd of Hermas 69 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/SHE_069_page_001.jpg

---

## Similitude 7 — The Value of Affliction; Hermas's Household

**69:1** After I had seen all these things I said to him: "Lord, I wish to know one more thing about those who repent." "Speak," he said. "Are the repentances of all those who repent beneficial — that is, does their repentance acquire life for them?" "All who repent with their whole heart," he said, "and who cleanse themselves from all their wickedness mentioned before, and who do not add sins to their previous sins — these obtain healing for their previous sins, if they are not double-minded about these commandments, and they shall live to God."

**69:2** "But do those who do not repent but persist in their pleasures," I said, "obtain life?" "They shall not obtain life," he said.

**69:3** "But, lord, I heard from some teachers," I said, "that there is no second repentance beyond that of the water." "True," he said. "That is correct. For he who has received forgiveness of sins ought never to sin again, but to live in purity. Since, however, you inquire precisely concerning all things, I will explain even this to you — not in order to give excuse to those who are going to believe or who have already believed in the Lord."

**69:4** "For those who have already believed or who shall hereafter believe do not need repentance from sins — they have forgiveness of sins already. But those who were called before and sinned, these have the possibility of repentance. And this repentance, as I have said, is unique and final. For the same man is not to repent again and again."

---

*EMET renders the Greek of P.Mich. 130 with maximal literalness, preserving Hermas's "second repentance" doctrine in Similitude 7.*
